# ShipShape

> ShipShape is an open-source, agent-ready starter template for full-stack, cloud-native apps (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Docker, Helm, Kubernetes, OpenTofu, GitHub Actions). It ships CI with one required `ci-success` check, Trivy and gitleaks security scanning, unit/integration/Playwright/kind tests, PR hygiene, and skills and hooks for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor). The repo-audit skill scores any repository on 96 best-practice checks.

Every command is a `make` target; `make check` is the pre-push gate and matches CI.

## Start here
